gate.title.snapshot: module-snapshot gate (a cross-module import of a mutable global is a stale copy)
snapshot.title: Module-snapshot gate
snapshot.ok: Snapshot gate: OK (%(files)d files; no cross-module copies of mutable globals)
snapshot.empty_scan: the scan surface is empty — empty is not a pass (zero-value guard)
snapshot.scan_empty_dir: scan surface %(root)s is an empty directory — an empty input is not 'no snapshot risk'
snapshot.mutable_copy: %(file)s does `from %(source)s import %(imported)s`, which is a **copy by value**: %(source)s reassigns it, but the copy froze at import time (use `import %(source)s` and read `%(source)s.%(imported)s` as an attribute)
knobs.sem.reflect_snapshot_root: source dir this gate scans (cross-module snapshot check). Empty ⇒ says out loud it is off
snapshot.derived_copy: %(file)s computes `%(derived)s = …` at module level from %(source)s.%(imported)s — that expression is evaluated once at import time and never follows later changes to %(source)s.%(imported)s (compute it inside a function, or read %(source)s.%(imported)s each time)
